generation.prompt: Create one original square 1:1 cinematic editorial photograph for BibleQuest V7 anxiety_worry emotion tile. Frame a strong central upper-half focal point readable at 100px, keep face and hands safely away from edges, reserve lower area for potential live UI. Emotion must read as anxiety rather than generic sadness. No text, logos, watermark, fake signage, Bible, crosses, mountain sunset, overdramatization, or copied app imagery. Premium cinematic editorial realism with quiet spiritual warmth.
